content.text: 8. CHECK PRESSURE READING WITH STEERING WHEEL TURNED TO FULL LOCK
Be sure the pressure gauge valve is fully opened and the engine idling.
If pressure is low, the gear housing has an internal leak and must be repaired or replaced.

content.description: Diagram showing pressure gauge setup with minimum pressure specification of 65 kg/cm², with valve in open position and steering wheel at full lock (1 rpm position indicated)

content.text: Center the steering wheel and run the engine at idle.
Using a scale, measure the steering effort in both directions.
Maximum steering effort: 4 kg (8.8 lb, 39 N)
If steering effort is excessive, repair the power steering unit.
NOTE: Be sure to consider tire type, pressure and contact surface before making your diagnosis.

content.description: Diagram showing steering wheel from above with a pull scale attached to measure steering effort
